zh: one of Britain's largest chains of supermarkets. It was started by Jack Cohen (1898-1979), a Jewish immigrant who started selling tea in a market in the East End of London just after the First World War. The name Tesco was used first in 1924 on a brand of tea sold by Cohen; it consisted of the first letters of T E Stockwell, who was a partner in a firm that supplied the tea, and the first two letters of Cohen's own name. In 1929 Cohen opened a food shop in London, and by the beginning of the Second World War there were many more Tesco shops in or near London. In the 1970s, Tesco superstores began to appear and there are now thousands of shops across Britain, in or just outside most towns and cities. The largest ones sell not only food but also clothes and household goods, as well as providing other services. In 1997 Tesco started its own bank, and in 2003 it began offering mobile phone services. It also has stores in many countries across the world.

ex: a computer that can process text
能处理文本的电脑

zh: 文本编辑系统（或程序）；文字编辑器
en: a system or program that allows you to make changes to text
a written message that you send using a mobile phone
ex: Send a text message to this number to vote.
请发短信到此号码参加投票。

en: to send somebody a written message using a mobile phone
ex: I text-messaged him to say we were waiting in the pub.
我发短信告诉他我们在酒吧里等候。

en: the act of sending written messages using a mobile phone
ex: Too much text-messaging can cause serious injury to the hands.
太多的短信会严重伤害手。

zh: 文本语音转换程序；语音朗读程序；文字至语音转换程序
en: a computer program that changes text into spoken language
ex: text-to-speech providing a variety of voices and accents
文字转语音提供各种声音和口音

en: a book that teaches a particular subject and that is used especially in schools and colleges
ex: a school/medical/history textbook
课本；医学／历史教科书

zh: 发送（手机）短信息的人；短信发送者
en: a person who sends text messages
any type of cloth made by weaving or knitting
ex: a factory producing a range of textiles
生产一系列纺织品的工厂

en: the act of sending written messages using a mobile phone
ex: Too much texting can cause serious injury to the hands.
发短信过多会严重伤害手。

zh: 短信文，短信用语（尤用于手机短信的缩略词、首字母、符号等）
en: the kind of language that is typically used in text messages, for example short forms of words, initials, symbols, etc.
ex: Using textspeak in the classroom could make lessons more fun and get kids wanting to learn.
在教室里使用文字讲话可以使课程变得更加有趣，并使孩子们想学习。

en: connected with or contained in a text
ex: textual analysis
文本分析

en: relating to texture
ex: the textural characteristics of the rocks
岩石的纹理特征

zh: （音乐或文学的）和谐统一感，神韵
en: the way a surface, substance or piece of cloth feels when you touch it, for example how rough, smooth, hard or soft it is
ex: the soft texture of velvet
天鹅绒柔软的质地

en: with a surface that is not smooth, but has a particular texture
ex: textured wallpaper
起纹理的壁纸
